# Georgia SEO Company

> SEO and web design for Georgia businesses

Georgia SEO Company is a registered Georgia company based at 246 N 5th Ave SW, Rome, GA 30165. Owner and operator: Eric Kirby. Phone: (762) 999-7265. The company serves service and trade businesses across Georgia, working from Rome in the northwest of the state.

## Services

- [SEO Services for Georgia Businesses](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/seo-services/): SEO services for Georgia businesses, run from Rome: local SEO for the map pack, a website Google can read, clean listings, earned links and a monthly report.
- [Web Design in Rome, GA, With the Search Work Built In](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/web-design/): Web design in Rome, GA for Georgia service and trade businesses: phone-first websites with the SEO built in, plus redesigns, WordPress fixes and online stores.
- [Google My Business Management for Georgia Businesses](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/google-business-profile-management/): Google My Business management for Georgia businesses: categories, service areas, photos and reviews kept current, and your map position checked town by town.
- [A Free SEO Audit of Your Rankings, Profile and Website](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/seo-audit/): A free SEO audit for Georgia businesses: current rankings, Google Business Profile health, and website checks, with specific findings and no obligation.
- [AI SEO: What ChatGPT and Gemini Read Before They Name a Business](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/ai-search-visibility/): AI SEO for Georgia businesses: what ChatGPT and Gemini search before they answer, what your website should say, and the AI Overview read we run every month.
- [Google Review Management for Georgia Businesses](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/review-management/): Review management for Georgia businesses: one ask to every customer after the job, a reply to every review, and a report on reviews that break Google's rules.
